contributions.detail: 4 Schedule A rows sum to 1000 + 500 + 1000 + 2888.90 = 5,388.90 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = the schedule's printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 5388.90 (this is the filer's first and only 2020 report of record on this channel, so period equals year-to-date) and is NOT summed as an increment — the per-period Box B is the anchor. Three printed anchors agree to the cent.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 5388.90 on the p4 Summary Page, which equals Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 5388.90 AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report)' 5388.90
expenditures.detail: 8 Schedule B rows sum to 45.00 + 50.00 + 715.46 + 127.93 + 25.00 + 2719.50 + 706.01 + 1000 = 5,388.90 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed Total Expenditures Made = the cover's promoted per-period cell Box D. Box E YTD also prints 5388.90 and is retained as cumulative, never summed. Box F (Subtotal before Expenditures = A + B) prints 5388.90 and the unlettered 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)' prints 0, so the whole ladder closes: 0 + 5388.90 - 5388.90 = 0.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and it is untestable-because-identical here: neither schedule prints an in-kind column or marker, no row carries an in-kind annotation, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind sums are the same figure and BOTH close at 5,388.90 on each side. Tested both per the per-filing rule; no in-kind entries exist on this filing.

itemized.notes: Anthony Canto, 2020 Utah County Surveyor. modern_boxAF, revision 'v. 4.20' (footer-printed on all four pages), born-digital fillable form printed and re-scanned — EVERY FIGURE IS MACHINE TYPE, so no glyph was in dispute anywhere on this filing. FOUR pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates'), p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' — the summary page is LAST, as ADDENDUM I3 predicts for this variant, but it was located by its heading, not by ordinal. NO checklist decoy on this filing. PAGE FACE: candidate 'Anthony Canto', Office field 'Utah County Surveyor', report type radio filled = 'Seven days preceding the General Election', signature Date 'Oct 26, 2020', Date of Report 'Oct 26, 2020' — all agreeing with index.csv's candidate and office. NEITHER amendment radio (No / Yes) is filled: an honest BLANK, never read as 'No'. The Page field of the bottom-left box is left blank on all four sheets (a fifth foliation practice for this corpus — no foliation at all). REDACTION, judged PER CELL from the page (ADDENDUM I4): the ONLY blacked-out region in the whole document is the signature bar on p1; every donor and vendor line on pp2-3 is published IN THE CLEAR, including full street addresses. Those street lines were reduced to city at READ TIME and no street fragment reaches this record, not even a note. DUPLICATE SCREEN: index.csv also carries a SECOND 2020 Canto filing (the county_api document Canto_Anthony_89fda05c27.pdf, reporting_period '30 Days after General', the one whose three source URLs collapse to one sha256 — the county's documented re-posting of ONE document under two report-period labels). THIS filing is a different document and a different report: it is the county_2020_page copy, its page face reads 'Seven days preceding the General Election' dated Oct 26 2020, and it is not in my chunk alongside the other. No differencing of any kind was done between them. BOTH SIDES CLOSE EXACTLY on the promoted per-period cells (Box B / Box D = 5388.90 each), each corroborated by TWO further printed figures on the schedule itself, and the summary ladder closes to 0. Utah County's filing fee does not appear on this Schedule B and was not used to corroborate anything (prohibited).
